## El Shorouk / الشروق — prices 2026

Asking averages (Aqarmap, viewed 2026-10-26), EGP/m² apartments:
Compounds 47,850 · Hay 5 38,200 · Hay 7 22,650 · Hay 9 22,300 · Family housing 19,950 · … · Zone 4 14,600.
City-wide asking mix ~29,800 EGP/m² (misleading because compounds pull the average up).
Full table: https://www.lenaqar.com/guides/el-shorouk/prices-2026
